title: Accounts Payable Officer
description:
As an Accounts Payable Officer, you will manage supplier invoices and payment activity across the business helping the finance function keep records accurate and up to date. You will handle the day-to-day accounts payable work that supports smooth financial administration across the business.

Client Details

The organisation is a well known and highly regarded organisation in North Macclesfield. They offer a range of brilliant benefits including free parking, competitive pension and holiday package and 1 day a week working from home. The company offers excellent career development and opportunities

Description

As an Accounts Payable Officer duties will include but are not limited to:
- Process supplier invoices accurately and ensure they are recorded promptly in the finance system.
